title: Tessallite-UI-Specs document
description: An OpenUI document (name, version, description, components) extended with structures: single-parent trees of typed nodes that document the containment and behaviour of a user interface. No layout or visual fields exist in this schema.

name.description: OpenUI: name of the UI library or product.

version.description: OpenUI: version of the UI library or product.

description.description: OpenUI: overview of the UI library or product.

license.description: OpenUI (as used by published specifications): licence of the library.

tuis.description: Version of the Tessallite-UI-Specs specification this document follows. Use "0.1".

components.description: OpenUI: component definitions keyed by component name.

Identifier.description: An identifier: a letter followed by letters, digits, underscore, dot, colon or hyphen.

Structures.description: Structures keyed by structure name. Each is one screen, surface or reusable subtree with a single root node.

description.description: What this structure is: the screen or surface it documents.

Component.description: OpenUI component definition with the extension fields events, states, slots and structure (or their x- forms).

package.description: OpenUI: package or module where the component is located.

group.description: OpenUI (as used by published specifications): grouping of the component.

example.description: OpenUI: example usage of the component.

props.description: OpenUI: map of prop name to a type string or a Prop object.

Prop.description: OpenUI prop: a type string, or an object with type, description, default, enum, required (plus items and properties for array and object types).

oneOf.description: The prop's data type, as a shorthand for an object with only type.

type.description: OpenUI: data type of the prop (string, boolean, number, array, object, or a named type).

description.description: OpenUI: explanation of the prop's purpose and usage.

default.description: OpenUI: default value when the prop is omitted.

enum.description: OpenUI: allowable values of an enumerated prop.

required.description: OpenUI: whether the prop must be provided.

items.description: Item shape when type is array (as used by published OpenUI specifications).

properties.description: Field shapes when type is object (as used by published OpenUI specifications).

EventDefinitions.description: Events the component emits, in Custom Elements Manifest shape.

name.description: Event name as emitted, for example change or onSelect.

description.description: When the event is emitted and what it carries.

type.description: Type of the event payload, for example CustomEvent<Persona> or (id: string) => void.

Slots.description: Named insertion points a component or node accepts. The empty-string name is the default slot.

name.description: Slot name. Empty string for the default slot.

StateName.description: A state from vocabulary/states.md or custom:<name>.

States.description: States the node or component can take. Each entry is a state name or an object with name, description and present.

description.description: When the node is in this state and what it shows.

present.description: Ids of the descendants that exist in this state; descendants not listed are absent.

Action.description: An action from vocabulary/actions.md or custom:<name>.

Event.description: What happens when the user or the system acts on a node.

event.description: The trigger: click, change, submit, keydown, open, close, drop, hover, focus, or a custom name.

handler.description: The symbol in code that handles the event, for example onOpenDrill or handleKeyDown.

actions.description: One or more actions, in order, from vocabulary/actions.md.

effect.description: What the user observes, in one or two sentences.

target.description: Id of the node the action acts on, when it is another node.

emits.description: Name of the component event raised, required when actions contains emit.

keys.description: Keys that trigger the event when event is keydown, for example ArrowRight or Enter.

condition.description: When the event applies, if not always.

Implementation.description: Where the node lives in code.

technology.description: The technology, for example react, web-component, swiftui.

file.description: Source file path relative to the repository root.

symbol.description: Exported symbol or function that renders the node.

tag.description: Element or tag name rendered, for example header, nav, MuiIconButton.

Column.description: A column definition on a table. Columns are not nodes; cells reference them by id.

id.description: Column id, unique within the table.

name.description: Column header text as the user sees it.

type.description: Data type of the column values: string, number, date, boolean, or a named type.

sortable.description: Whether the user can sort by this column.

repeat.description: This column definition stands for N data-driven columns (one per element of the table's data.columns binding). A cell that names it is the repeated cell of its row.

TrackList.description: A count of tracks, or an array of unique track names. Never a size.

Tracks.description: The tracks of a grid: columns (required) and rows (optional).

TrackRef.description: A track by 1-based index or by name.

Placement.description: Where a child of a grid sits: column and row by index or name, and how many tracks it spans.

A11y.description: Accessibility facts: role, ARIA attributes and keyboard behaviour.

role.description: The accessibility role, for example banner, tablist, alert, dialog.

aria.description: ARIA attributes by name (without the aria- prefix or with it), value as text.

additionalProperties.description: Attribute value as text, boolean or number.

key.description: The key or key combination, for example ArrowRight, Enter, Ctrl+Enter.

NodeType.description: A node type from vocabulary/node-types.md or custom:<name>.

Node.description: One node of a structure tree. Every node has an id and a type; everything else is optional. Containment is the only positional information.

id.description: Identifier unique across the whole document.

kind.description: visible: the user sees or operates it. logical: a grouping that exists for structure only.

name.description: Human name of the node for readers of the document; not shown to the user.

condition.description: When the node exists, if not always: a plain expression over the runtime state, for example profiles.length > 0. A node without condition always exists in the states that list it.

label.description: The text the user sees or hears: visible text, caption, or the accessible name of an icon. Required on icon, icon-button, image and chart.

i18n.description: Key of the string resource that supplies label, for example app.title.

icon.description: URI of the icon shown, relative to the document unless absolute. SVG recommended.

component.description: Name of the component in components that this node is an instance of.

$ref.description: Reuse: #/components/<Name> or #/structures/<name>. The node stands for the referenced structure and may override its fields.

props.description: Prop values for this instance, keyed by prop name.

implementation.description: Where the node lives in code.

data.description: Data bindings: binding name to expression. collection names the collection a repeat child iterates.

tokens.description: W3C Design Token names the node references. Names only, never values.

events.description: What happens when the user or the system acts on this node.

slot.description: The slot of the parent that this node fills.

columns.description: Column definitions. Only on a table.

column.description: The column this cell belongs to. Only on a cell.

tracks.description: Grid tracks. Only on a grid.

placement.description: Position in the parent grid. Only on a direct child of a grid.

repeat.description: This node is the item template of its parent and stands for N instances.

presentation.description: overlay: the node floats over its owner rather than sitting inside its flow.
